items.title: Jim H. Dunbar Jr. Interview, 1959-11-28
items.q: So, here's another thing, Dick. This also, I think, has bearing... You'd know more about that than I...

ctx.x: Myself, I don't. I think Bill's pretty agitated all the time. And he's always running around on a car like that. And he's always worried and anxious and fearful.

So, here's another thing, Dick. This also, I think, has bearing, you know, it's a great American dream when you write a song, you get it published so people will buy it and make you money and you'll become famous. Or when you, well, no matter what form of endeavor you happen to practice, we do it for some sort of reward, material or otherwise.
